# awscc_lambda_runtime_alias (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Lambda::RuntimeAlias. A mutable named pointer to a specific runtime version.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The alias name.
- `runtime_name` (String) The name of the parent runtime.
- `runtime_version` (String) The runtime version this alias points to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the runtime alias.
- `release_lifecycle` (Attributes) The publisher's lifecycle declaration for the alias. Omitting it removes any stored declaration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--release_lifecycle))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the runtime alias.
- `compatibility` (Attributes) Compatibility matrix for the runtime version the alias points to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--compatibility))
- `created` (String) The timestamp when the runtime alias was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_modified` (String) The timestamp when the runtime alias was last modified.
- `runtime_version_arn` (String) The ARN of the runtime version this alias points to.
- `state` (String) The lifecycle state of the runtime alias.

<a id="nestedatt--release_lifecycle"></a>
### Nested Schema for `release_lifecycle`

Optional:

- `deprecation_date` (String) The date on which the alias becomes deprecated. A UTC calendar date in yyyy-mm-dd format.
- `function_create_block_date` (String) The date on which creating new functions on this alias is blocked. A UTC calendar date in yyyy-mm-dd format.
- `function_update_block_date` (String) The date on which updating existing functions on this alias is blocked. A UTC calendar date in yyyy-mm-dd format.
- `release_state` (String) The release state of the alias. DEPRECATED requires a DeprecationDate on or before today (UTC); PREVIEW and GA require a later DeprecationDate, or none. Reads report DEPRECATED once DeprecationDate is reached.


<a id="nestedatt--compatibility"></a>
### Nested Schema for `compatibility`

Read-Only:

- `architectures` (Set of String)
- `integration_models` (Set of String)
- `managed_instances` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_lambda_runtime_alias.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the runtime alias

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_lambda_runtime_alias.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_lambda_runtime_alias.example "arn"
```
